name: Detective Rico Vega
bio: A round, rolling detective on the felt in CUE VICE. Miami, 1986. Looking for the Shark.

portrait.subject: a cute round chibi 80s Miami detective with slicked hair, a pastel pink jacket over a teal t-shirt, aviator sunglasses pushed up, holding a pool cue
portrait.background: neon Miami night with palm trees and pink sky

request: Rico Vega, Miami Vice... er, CUE VICE. Need a partner I can trust. You? 🎱
hello: Good. My last partner... well. Let's not.
The Shark's out there. We roll careful.
about: Detective Rico Vega. My partner died on a bust somebody sold out. The trail leads from a Coconut Grove marina to a kingpin called the Shark.
how: Stealth action on a pool table: pull back and let go to roll your squad, sneak past guards and take down the Shark's crew.
tips: Bank shots around corners. Guards can't see them coming.
Soft shots for stealth, hard shots for takedowns.
chat: Bought a new jacket. Pastel. Obviously.
The marina smells like fish and lies.
Someone rolled a cue ball at me. Old-school threat.
Partner tip: never trust a guy named Shark.
nudge: Got a lead on the Shark. Roll out?
New job at the marina. You in, partner?
idle: {ago} off the case, partner? The Shark's not resting.
The precinct's been quiet for {ago}. I don't like it.
update: Precinct memo: CUE VICE now v{version}.
